description:
Non-Material Amendment to planning permission reference 211244 granted 09/05/2022 to 2021
to change the wording of Conditions, 8, 31 and 36. The change is required as it has become apparent that accreditation cannot occur prior to
occupation therefore the amended timescale will give the Trust, who will be responsible for
discharging the condition, enough time to obtain the accreditation without putting the occupation of
the MSCP at risk.
